cohort: 48 women who underwent cesarean myomectomy and 114 women who underwent cesarean delivery alone, all with uterine leiomyomas and singleton pregnancies
finding: Cesarean myomectomy, when performed by an experienced obstetrician in selected patients without additional risk factors for hemorrhage, was not associated with increased adverse outcomes compared to cesarean delivery alone.
mod_finding: Cesarean myomectomy itself was not associated with adverse outcomes compared to CD alone.
